highlights: Glass panels: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) over rgba(0,0,0,0.18) with 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) border - used extensively on property card badges
Progress indicators: White fill (bg-white!) on semi-transparent white track (bg-white/50!) for image carousel navigation

Subtle shadows: Multiple shadow variants including shadow-dropdown (0px 2px 16px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.039), 0px 0.5px 8px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.078)), shadow-modal, shadow-searchbar, shadow-toast for depth hierarchy
Backdrop blur effects: Various blur levels (blur-sm: 8px, blur-md: 12px, blur-lg: 12px, blur-xl: 16px) used for glassmorphism surfaces
Badge overlays: Glassmorphism badges on property cards with backdrop-blur-lg, border border-neutral-1000/5, and bg-neutral-1000/18
